title: Elodie and the Harbor
author: Dominic Villalobos
blurb: Elodie Pemberton, a code-carrying courier on the last diplomatic mission of a doomed republic, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints before the ice breaks on the river.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
